Creeps and Curses V.3.1

Major Cursed Technique. Example technique for sorcerers and NPCs (GM approval).

Defensive Mode

As an action or reaction for 5 Cursed Energy, you will surround yourself in cursed energy making any attack or effect with a guaranteed hit nullified and deal no damage. This technique lasts for 1 minute, however it does not affect attacks without a guaranteed hit.

Offensive Mode

You can also use this technique offensively while wielding a melee weapon. As an action for 4 Cursed Energy, you can surround yourself in cursed energy to prepare for an attack for 1 minute. As a reaction to an attack, you can make a melee weapon attack at advantage against the attacker before the attack happens. On a hit, the attack counts as a critical hit and deals necrotic damage. Once you make this attack, you must reactivate the technique to use it again. If your cursed energy or innate technique alters damage types, it can also alter the damage type of Falling Blossom Emotion.
